legal_units.title: Deduction in respect of contribution to Agnipath Scheme.
legal_units.text: An assessee, being an individual who has enrolled in the Agnipath Scheme and subscribes to the Agniveer Corpus Fund on or after the 1st November, 2022, shall be allowed a deduction in the computation of his total income, of the whole of the amount paid or deposited in his account in the said Fund during the tax year.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Chapter VIII DEDUCTIONS TO BE MADE IN COMPUTING TOTAL INCOME Chapter VIII, Division B Deductions in respect of certain payments Section 125 Deduction in respect of contribution to Agnipath Scheme. Section 125(1): An assessee, being an individual who has enrolled in the Agnipath Scheme and subscribes to the Agniveer Corpus Fund on or after the 1st November, 2022, shall be allowed a deduction in the computation of his total income, of the whole of the amount paid or deposited in his account in the said Fund during the tax year.
legal_units.chapter_title: DEDUCTIONS TO BE MADE IN COMPUTING TOTAL INCOME
legal_units.division_title: Deductions in respect of certain payments

legal_units.title: Deduction in respect of contribution to Agnipath Scheme.
legal_units.text: Where the Central Government makes any contribution to the account of an assessee in the Fund referred to in sub-section (1), the assessee shall be allowed a deduction in the computation of his total income of the whole of the amount so contributed.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Chapter VIII DEDUCTIONS TO BE MADE IN COMPUTING TOTAL INCOME Chapter VIII, Division B Deductions in respect of certain payments Section 125 Deduction in respect of contribution to Agnipath Scheme. Section 125(2): Where the Central Government makes any contribution to the account of an assessee in the Fund referred to in sub-section (1), the assessee shall be allowed a deduction in the computation of his total income of the whole of the amount so contributed.
